cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my bag on my head like you. Mine's heavier; I won't let you do more for this picnic than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was keeping it out of the puddle while I tied my shoe. Put it in the cart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, keep it dry. I'll push the cart while you rest; I've packed all your favourite food too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me push. You've already done the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll push you right to the picnic spot if you like. You can eat the first sandwich on the way.

reason: Build an actual mistaken imitation into the shared activity, preserving distinct competitive-care, hopeful-connection, warm-resentment, emotional-pricing, and self-serving-repair tactics.
